proof: For A,B on the same side of a straight bank and G the reflection of B, every bank point P satisfies PB=PG. Therefore AP+PB=AP+PG>=AG by triangle inequality, with equality at the intersection of segment AG and the bank. This point lies inside the displayed bank. Reflection gives equal angles to the bank. The later B position changes the optimizer by the same formula.
